---
title: "Milestone4_HanSun"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)   
library(ggplot2)
review_data <- read_csv("../data/clean/primarycleaned_reviews_data.csv")
```

```{r}
review_data <- review_data %>%
  mutate(stars= as.character(stars))
ggplot(data = review_data, aes(x=review_length, color = stars))+
  geom_density() + 
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Reviews Length by Stars",
    x = "Character Count of Review"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

review_data_shortreview <- review_data%>%
  filter(review_length <= 1000)
ggplot(data = review_data_shortreview, aes(x=stars, y=review_length)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  labs(
    title = "Word Count vs. Stars (Character Count <= 1000)",
    y = "Character Count of Review"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

review_data_edited <- review_data %>%
  filter(written_time != edited_time)

review_data_notedited <- review_data %>%
  filter(written_time == edited_time)

ggplot(data = review_data_edited, aes(x=stars)) +
  geom_bar() + 
  labs(
    title = "Count of Stars for the Editted Comments"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

ggplot(data = review_data_notedited, aes(x=stars)) +
  geom_bar() + 
  labs(
    title = "Count of Stars for the Not Editted Comments"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```
Feedbacks: Combine stars, use bar plot for density, slice the data by character count smaller to avoid too many outliers.
